questions.q: In an election between three candidates, the third-placed candidate received 1000 valid votes. From the remaining votes, the elected candidate received 5000 more votes than the runner-up candidate, accounting for $52\%$ of the total votes cast. If $16\%$ of votes were declared invalid (given that all the voters cast their vote), then the total number of cast votes was?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, variables ko total ke percentage terms me rakh kar equation balance karni hai, seedha $20x$ ki value aayegi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): W aur R ka gap base pakad. Mathematically :-
$$52x - (84x - 52x - 1000) = 5000$$
$$20x = 4000 \Rightarrow 100x = 20000$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Tree distribution method. Mathematically :-
$$Valid = 100x - 16x = 84x$$
$$W + R + 1000 = 84x$$
$$R = 32x - 1000$$
$$W - R = 5000$$
$$20x = 4000 \Rightarrow x = 200 \Rightarrow 100x = 20000$$

Exam Takeaway: Election wale questions me tree diagram dimaag me set rakh aur ek hi variable me sab solve kar de.

List IList II
Single Variable BaseAlways split 100x into logical branches (Valid, Invalid).

questions.q: In a certain college, each of 240 students can speak at least one language. The total number of Hindi speaking students are $(2x+10)\%$ and the total number of urdu speaking students are $(x+20)\%$. If $(x-10)\%$ of total students can speak both the languages, then find students who speak only urdu is what percent of the students who speak only Hindi.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 240 ka koi kaam nahi hai, ye sirf darane ki ninja technique hai! Seedha saare percentages ko $100\%$ ke barabar rakh de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Union formula lagao aur value nikalo. Mathematically :-
$$100 = (2x+10) + (x+20) - (x-10)$$
$$100 = 2x + 40 \Rightarrow 2x = 60 \Rightarrow x = 30$$
$$Only\_H = 70 - 20 = 50\%$$
$$Only\_U = 50 - 20 = 30\%$$
$$\frac{30}{50} \times 100 = 60\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Detailed Set Theory. Mathematically :-
$$n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$$
$$100\% = (2x+10)\% + (x+20)\% - (x-10)\%$$
$$100 = 2x + 40 \Rightarrow x = 30$$
$$Hindi = 70\%, Urdu = 50\%, Both = 20\%$$
$$\frac{50 - 20}{70 - 20} \times 100 = 60\%$$

Exam Takeaway: Venn diagram banane ki zarurat nahi agar formula dimag me clear ho. Sirf percentage pe khelo.

List IList II
Absolute values neglectIgnore total number when answer is asked in percentage.

questions.q: A student scored $20\%$ more marks in Math than in Science. If the average of his marks in both subjects is 66, what are his marks in Science? (CHSL TIER I-$\frac{15}{11}$/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, Math me Science se $20\%$ zyada hai matlab ratio 6:5 aayega. Dono ka average 66 hai toh total 132 hoga.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha ratio equate kar. Mathematically :-
$$Ratio = 6:5 \Rightarrow Total = 11$$
$$11 \rightarrow 132$$
$$1 \rightarrow 12$$
$$Science (5) \rightarrow 60$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fraction concept se. Mathematically :-
$$20\% = \frac{1}{5}$$
$$M:S = 6:5$$
$$Avg = \frac{11}{2} = 5.5 \rightarrow 66$$
$$1 \rightarrow 12$$
$$Science = 5 \times 12 = 60$$

Exam Takeaway: Fraction aur unit method se average seconds me nikalta hai, x assume mat karna kabhi.

List IList II
Fraction Logic$20\%$ more means direct 6:5 ratio on base 5.

questions.q: In a state election between two parties, $83\%$ of the voters cast their votes, out of which $4\%$ of the votes were declared invalid. Party A got 156611 votes which were $83\%$ of the total valid votes. Find the total number of votes enrolled in that election. (Consider integer part only)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, decimal multiplication bohot lamba jayega, nearest approximation nikal kar sidha options tick mark karna hai kyuki gap bahut hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Approximation ka khel. Mathematically :-
$$0.83 \times 0.96 \times 0.83 \approx 0.69 \times 0.96 \approx 0.66$$
$$Total = \frac{156611}{0.66} \approx 237000$$
$$Closest = 236807$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Chain rule ka exact setup. Mathematically :-
$$Total \times \frac{83}{100} \times \frac{96}{100} \times \frac{83}{100} = 156611$$
$$Total \times 0.661248 = 156611$$
$$Total = 236841 \approx 236807$$

Exam Takeaway: Jab options dur ho toh decimal ki approx values leke answer pe jump maar, SSC aisi calculations chhodne ke liye deta hai agar trick na pata ho.

List IList II
Smart GuessTake nearest clean fraction (like 2/3 for 0.66).

questions.q: A company allowed $16\%$ commission on the total sales made by salesman and a bonus of $6\%$ on the sales over 7000. If the salesman deposited $\text{Rs. } 8610$ in the company after deducting his earning from the total sales made by him. Find total sales?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, imaginary commission method se salesman ko starting ke 7000 par bhi $6\%$ bonus de de, toh overall uniform $22\%$ commission ban jayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Shift method. Mathematically :-
$$Extra\_Bonus = 6\% \text{ of } 7000 = 420$$
$$New\_Deposit = 8610 - 420 = 8190$$
$$78\% = 8190$$
$$100\% = 10500$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic algebra. Mathematically :-
$$S = \text{Total Sales}$$
$$S - [0.16S + 0.06(S - 7000)] = 8610$$
$$S - 0.22S + 420 = 8610$$
$$0.78S = 8190 \Rightarrow S = 10500$$

Exam Takeaway: Imaginary len-den se rate uniform banaya kar, bahut time bachega aur calculations seedhi 1 step me aayengi.

List IList II
Income ShiftingHypothetically uniform the commission to find the base easily.

Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, standard fractions ko pehchan aur zero cancel kar seedha answer nikal le dimag me.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Mental fractions. Mathematically :-
$$80\% \rightarrow \frac{4}{5}$$
$$37.5\% \rightarrow \frac{3}{8}$$
$$280 - 60 + 55 = 275$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Step by step scaling. Mathematically :-
$$\frac{4}{5} \times 350 - \frac{3}{8} \times 160 + \frac{11}{100} \times 500$$
$$280 - 60 + 55 = 275$$

Exam Takeaway: Fractional equivalents dimag me set hone chahiye, tabhi speed badhegi simplification me.

List IList II
Standard values$37.5\% = 3/8, 80\% = 4/5$

questions.q: In an examination every question correctly answered fetches two marks and for every question wrongly answered one mark is deducted. Anusha and Preet took the examination. Anusha attempted a certain number of question and $20\%$ of them went wrong. Preet attempted a certain number of questions and $10\%$ of the questions attempted by him went wrong. Anusha got 33 marks more than the pass mark and Preet got 48 marks more than the pass mark. Anusha and Preet together attempted 100 questions. What is the pass mark of the examination?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, accuracy aur marks per question ko combine kar net marks ki expected value nikal, uske baad simple linear equation se turant khatam ho jayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Net marking per attempt. Mathematically :-
$$A_{net} = 0.8(2) - 0.2(1) = 1.4$$
$$P_{net} = 0.9(2) - 0.1(1) = 1.7$$
$$1.7(100 - A) - 1.4A = 15$$
$$170 - 3.1A = 15 \Rightarrow 3.1A = 155 \Rightarrow A = 50$$
$$Pass = 50 \times 1.4 - 33 = 37$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Traditional variable mapping. Mathematically :-
$$A + P = 100$$
$$P_{score} - A_{score} = 48 - 33 = 15$$
$$P_{score} = P \times (0.9 \times 2 - 0.1 \times 1) = 1.7P$$
$$A_{score} = 1.4A$$
$$1.7(100 - A) - 1.4A = 15 \Rightarrow A = 50$$
$$Score = 70 \Rightarrow Pass = 70 - 33 = 37$$

Exam Takeaway: Har attempt ka net weightage nikal ke calculation ekdum half ho jati hai.

List IList II
Expected ValueProb(Right) x Reward - Prob(Wrong) x Penalty

questions.q: A shopkeeper at Garbar Jhala, Aminabad first increases the price of an ornament by x%, then he decreases the new price by x%. After one such up-down cycle, the price of the ornament decreases by $\text{Rs. } 21025$. After the second up-down cycle, the ornament is sold for $\text{Rs. } 484416$. What was the original price of the ornament?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $x\%$ up aur $x\%$ down humesha net loss karta hai, options se base utha ke multiplier check kar, reverse engineering best hai yaha.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Options se base uthao aur hit karo. Mathematically :-
$$\frac{21025}{525625} = \frac{1}{25} = 4\%$$
$$Cycle_1 = 525625 - 21025 = 504600$$
$$Cycle_2 = 504600 \times 0.96 = 484416$$
$$Matched!$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formula approach. Mathematically :-
$$Loss = \frac{x^2}{100}\%$$
$$P \times \left(1 - \frac{x^2}{10000}\right) = P - 21025 = C_1$$
$$C_1 \times \left(1 - \frac{x^2}{10000}\right) = 484416$$
$$Equation\text{ solving is too complex, use options!}$$

Exam Takeaway: Jab compound structure lamba ho toh sidha options se reverse engineer maar.

List IList II
Base StrategyCheck fractions from options that yield integer cuts.

questions.q: A fraction is reduced such that when it is squared and then its numerator is increased by $20\%$ and denominator is reduced by $25\%$, it results in $\frac{6}{5}$ of the original fraction. The product of the numerator and denominator is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, fraction change ko seedha multiplier me likh aur equation ko direct kaat, variable $F$ apne aap bahar aayegi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Direct decimal fraction. Mathematically :-
$$F^2 \times \frac{1.20}{0.75} = \frac{6}{5} F$$
$$F = \frac{6}{5} \times \frac{75}{120} = \frac{3}{4}$$
$$N \times D = 3 \times 4 = 12$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractional split method. Mathematically :-
$$F^2 \times \frac{\frac{6}{5}}{\frac{3}{4}} = \frac{6}{5} F$$
$$F^2 \times \frac{24}{15} = \frac{6}{5} F$$
$$F = \frac{6}{5} \times \frac{15}{24} = \frac{3}{4}$$
$$N \times D = 12$$

Exam Takeaway: Decimal multipliers use kar, values turant fraction form me cancel out hogi.

List IList II
Multiplier Hack$1.20 / 0.75 = 120 / 75$ instantly yields $8 / 5$ factor.

questions.q: In a co-educational school there are 15 more girls than boys. If the number of girls is increased by $10\%$ and the number of boys is also increased by $16\%$, there would be 9 more girls than boys. What is the number of students in the school ?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 2 linear equations ban rahi hain, G ko $(B + 15)$ rakh aur substitution maar ke khatam kar.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Variable elimination. Mathematically :-
$$1.1(B + 15) - 1.16B = 9$$
$$16.5 - 0.06B = 9$$
$$0.06B = 7.5 \Rightarrow B = 125$$
$$Total = 125 + (125+15) = 265$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Base assumptions from options. Mathematically :-
$$Total = 265$$
$$G + B = 265 \text{ and } G - B = 15$$
$$G = 140, B = 125$$
$$140 \times 1.1 - 125 \times 1.16 = 154 - 145 = 9$$

Exam Takeaway: Option split karke mentally verify karna linear equations se bhi fast hota hai kai baar.

List IList II
Option validationCheck pairs that sum to option and difference is 15.

questions.q: Ramesh can save $30\%$ of his income but after 4 years, his income increases by $42\%$ and he still manages to save the same amount as before. What is the percent increase in his expenditure ?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, savings bilkul same hai matlab jitni income badhi, utna hi paisa pura kharche me chala gaya. Seedha base se divide maar!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Direct absolute deviation. Mathematically :-
$$I = 100, S = 30, E = 70$$
$$\Delta I = 42 \Rightarrow \Delta E = 42$$
$$\% \Delta E = \frac{42}{70} \times 100 = 60\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic scaling map. Mathematically :-
$$New\_I = 142, New\_S = 30$$
$$New\_E = 142 - 30 = 112$$
$$Inc = 112 - 70 = 42$$
$$\frac{42}{70} \times 100 = 60\%$$

Exam Takeaway: Constant saving ke case me direct change in income ko Expenditure ka change maan liya kar.

List IList II
Direct EqualityWhen Savings is constant, Absolute Increase in I = Absolute Increase in E.

questions.q: A, B and C contested an election. All the votes polled were valid. A got $38\%$ of the total votes. For every 45 votes polled, B got 18 votes. The winner got 5,760 more votes than the person who received the least number of votes. The total number of votes polled was:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, B ko har 45 me se 18 milne ka matlab fraction ka sidha percentage $40\%$ pakad! Teeno ko ek percentage scale pe daal.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Percentage alignment. Mathematically :-
$$B = \frac{18}{45} \times 100 = 40\%$$
$$A = 38\%, C = 22\%$$
$$B - C = 18\%$$
$$18\% = 5760 \Rightarrow 100\% = 32000$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Absolute fractions. Mathematically :-
$$B = \frac{2}{5}Total$$
$$A = 0.38 Total$$
$$C = Total - (0.4 + 0.38)Total = 0.22 Total$$
$$0.4Total - 0.22Total = 5760 \Rightarrow Total = 32000$$

Exam Takeaway: Fraction dekhte hi percentage me convert hona chahiye dimag election waale sums me.

List IList II
Fraction conversion18 out of 45 -> 2/5 -> $40\%$

questions.q: Last year, Geeta's monthly salary was 12,000 and Seeta's monthly salary was 10,000. This year, Geeta's monthly salary is $\text{Rs. } 14$,400, while Seeta's monthly salary is $\text{Rs. } 12$,500. If the percentage increase in Seeta's monthly salary this year over her monthly salary last year is denoted by x%, and the percentage increase in Geeta's monthly salary this year over her monthly salary last year is denoted by y%, then what is the value of ((x-y)/y * 100) % ?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, lambe zeroes ko ignore kar. 12 se 14.4 aur 10 se 12.5 ka increment nikal aur direct fraction formule me daal de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Zero cut ratio. Mathematically :-
$$y = \frac{2.4}{12} \times 100 = 20\%$$
$$x = \frac{2.5}{10} \times 100 = 25\%$$
$$\frac{25-20}{20} \times 100 = 25\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Standard percentage change. Mathematically :-
$$y = \frac{14400 - 12000}{12000} \times 100 = 20\%$$
$$x = \frac{12500 - 10000}{10000} \times 100 = 25\%$$
$$\frac{x-y}{y} \times 100 = \frac{5}{20} \times 100 = 25\%$$

Exam Takeaway: Lambi statement me specific variable pe focus kar aur zero neglect mar ke speed badha.

List IList II
Decimals scalingBase ko 10 ya 120 me shift karke mentally diff measure karo.

questions.q: A metallic conical bowl with base radius 10 cm and height 24 cm is uniformly heated, increasing all dimensions by $10\%$. By how much does the volume increase? (CHSL TIER I - $\frac{30}{11}$/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, dimensions ka 10 cm aur 24 cm sirf trap hai, 3D volume humesha teen baar multiply hota hai, $10\%$ teen baar scaling!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): 3D Multiplier cube. Mathematically :-
$$Vol \propto r^2 h$$
$$Multiplier = 1.1 \times 1.1 \times 1.1 = 1.331$$
$$\Delta = 1.331 - 1 = 0.331 = 33.1\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fraction approach. Mathematically :-
$$\frac{11}{10} \times \frac{11}{10} \times \frac{11}{10} = \frac{1331}{1000}$$
$$\Delta = \frac{331}{1000} \times 100 = 33.1\%$$

Exam Takeaway: Geometric figures me uniform heating ya scaling me dimensions kabhi mat use karna.

List IList II
Volume ScalingCube the scaling factor directly.

questions.q: The monthly income of three persons A, B and C amounts to $\text{Rs. } 57$,000. They spend $70\%$, $75\%$ and $80\%$ of their respective incomes and save the remaining. The ratio of their savings is 4:5:6. Find the monthly income of C.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, savings ratio ko uske absolute percentage fraction se divide karke seedha income ka ratio pakad le, seconds me answer aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Direct ratio inversion. Mathematically :-
$$A = \frac{4}{0.3} = \frac{40}{3}$$
$$B = \frac{5}{0.25} = 20$$
$$C = \frac{6}{0.20} = 30$$
$$Ratio = 40:60:90 = 4:6:9$$
$$19 \rightarrow 57000 \Rightarrow 9 \rightarrow 27000$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable algebra. Mathematically :-
$$0.3I_a = 4k, 0.25I_b = 5k, 0.2I_c = 6k$$
$$I_a = \frac{40k}{3}, I_b = 20k, I_c = 30k$$
$$\frac{40k}{3} + 20k + 30k = 57000$$
$$190k = 171000 \Rightarrow k = 900$$
$$I_c = 30 \times 900 = 27000$$

Exam Takeaway: Income nikalne ke liye hamesha Savings Ratio ko unke percentage factor se divide karna best method hota hai.

List IList II
Reverse MappingBase = Result / Percentage Multiple.

questions.q: Due to an increase of $32\%$ in the price of pulse, a person reduces his consumption in such a way that his expenditure increases only by $10\%$. If he consumes 150 kg of pulse after the price has increased, then how much pulse was consumed by him initially?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, Constant Product Ratio (CPR) ki ninja trick laga, Initial aur Final consumption ka seedha fraction nikal.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): CPR direct fraction. Mathematically :-
$$\frac{Initial}{Final} = \frac{100 + P\%}{100 + E\%} = \frac{132}{110} = \frac{6}{5}$$
$$5 \rightarrow 150 \Rightarrow 1 \rightarrow 30$$
$$6 \rightarrow 180$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Traditional formula. Mathematically :-
$$P_{new} = 1.32 P_{old}$$
$$E_{new} = 1.10 E_{old}$$
$$C_{new} = \frac{E_{new}}{P_{new}} = \frac{1.10}{1.32} C_{old} = \frac{5}{6} C_{old}$$
$$\frac{5}{6} C_{old} = 150 \Rightarrow C_{old} = 180$$

Exam Takeaway: Price aur Expenditure ke percentages diye hon toh formula me base swap karke consumption ka ratio instantly ban jata hai.

List IList II
Ratio Direct HackC1 / C2 = (100 + E2\%) / (100 + P2\%) doesn't hold. Right hack is Initial/Final = (100+New Price) / (100+New Exp).

questions.q: Population a city increases by $41\frac{2}{3}\%$, 92000 in first and second year respectively but, in third year it decreases by $10\%$ and now population is thrice of initial population. Find the total increment in the population during the first year?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, fractional $41\frac{2}{3}\%$ dekhte hi denominator 12 strike karna chahiye. Initial population ko $12x$ man kar line by line change apply kar de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Scaled base assumption. Mathematically :-
$$41\frac{2}{3}\% = \frac{5}{12}$$
$$I_1 = 12x, I_2 = 17x$$
$$0.9(17x + 92000) = 3(12x)$$
$$17x + 92000 = 40x \Rightarrow 23x = 92000$$
$$x = 4000 \Rightarrow Inc = 5x = 20000$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Standard equation flow. Mathematically :-
$$P \times \left(1+\frac{5}{12}\right) = P + \frac{5}{12}P$$
$$\left(\frac{17P}{12} + 92000\right) \times 0.9 = 3P$$
$$\frac{17P}{12} + 92000 = \frac{10}{9} \times 3P = \frac{10P}{3}$$
$$92000 = \frac{40P - 17P}{12} = \frac{23P}{12}$$
$$P = 48000$$
$$Inc = \frac{5}{12} \times 48000 = 20000$$

Exam Takeaway: Fractional increments me original variable ko denominator ka perfect multiple assume karne se equations smooth banti hain.

List IList II
Fractions MagicAlways set variable base to LCM of fractional denominators.

questions.q: Ridhi scored 65 marks in Mathematics. He scored $70\%$ marks in Hindi and $(X^3 + 20)$ marks in English. The maximum marks for each subject is 80. The overall percentage of marks obtained by Riddhi in all three subjects together is $70\%$. Find X?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, overall average $70\%$ hai toh har subject me target marks set kar, jo average se extra laya usko dusre subjects se balance kar le.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Deviation Balance. Mathematically :-
$$Avg_{target} = 80 \times 0.70 = 56$$
$$H = 56 \text{ (0 dev)}$$
$$M = 65 \text{ (+9 dev)}$$
$$E_{target} = 56 - 9 = 47$$
$$X^3 + 20 = 47 \Rightarrow X^3 = 27 \Rightarrow X = 3$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Total Sum approach. Mathematically :-
$$Total = 80 \times 3 = 240$$
$$Obtained = 240 \times 0.70 = 168$$
$$65 + 56 + (X^3 + 20) = 168$$
$$141 + X^3 = 168 \Rightarrow X^3 = 27 \Rightarrow X=3$$

Exam Takeaway: Sabko add karke wapas minus karne se accha hai individual average deviation zero pe balance karna, isse calculation chhoti ho jati hai.

List IList II
Zero Sum RuleSum of deviations from exactly average is always zero.

questions.q: A mixture contains $60\%$ milk. If 20 liters of water is added to the 80-liter mixture, what is the new percentage of milk? (CGL TIER I - $\frac{22}{09}$/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, mixture me paani daloge toh paani badlega, lekin milk ki absolute amount constant rahegi. Wahi nikal ke naye base par percentage bana de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Constant element tracking. Mathematically :-
$$Milk = 80 \times 0.60 = 48$$
$$New\_Total = 80 + 20 = 100$$
$$\% = \frac{48}{100} \times 100 = 48\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractional proportion. Mathematically :-
$$Milk = \frac{3}{5} \times 80 = 48$$
$$Water = \frac{2}{5} \times 80 = 32$$
$$New\_Water = 32 + 20 = 52$$
$$\% = \frac{48}{48+52} \times 100 = 48\%$$

Exam Takeaway: Mixture me jo element intact rahe usi absolute value ko total target par naya percentage banane ke liye use kar.

List IList II
Constant AnchorNever track the changing element, track what remains unchanged.
